T: Steal through time. Stop for dinner.
D: A boy joins a gang of time-travelling thieves on a wild run through history with a stolen map of holes in time.
P: Serve the main when the boys reach Agamemnon's feast.
S: King Agamemnon's feast in ancient Greece
Olives, feta, cucumber and warm pita, a Greek feast platter fit for a king who adopts you on the spot.
Robin Hood and his merry men
Crusty bread, cheese and apples, a forest picnic with Robin Hood before the gang loses all the loot.
M: the ogre and his wife cooking dinner on their ship
A big pot of beef and vegetable stew, the friendly version of what the ogre had planned for the bandits.
W: Napoleon and his love of little things
Small custard tarts dusted with cinnamon, little cakes for a general obsessed with small things.
K: the boys' stop aboard the Titanic
Ginger ale over ice with lemon. Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour over 1.25L ginger ale.

s.note: King Agamemnon's feast in ancient Greece
s.how: Arrange 200g olives, 200g feta drizzled with oil and oregano, sliced cucumber and tomatoes on a platter. Warm 4 pita breads and cut into wedges.

s.note: Robin Hood and his merry men
s.how: Slice a crusty loaf and serve with 200g sharp cheddar and 3 sliced apples on a wooden board. Add a dish of pickle on the side.

m.note: the ogre and his wife cooking dinner on their ship
m.how: Brown 1kg diced chuck in batches. Add a chopped onion, 2 carrots, 2 potatoes and 750ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2 hours until tender. Serve with crusty bread.

w.note: Napoleon and his love of little things
w.how: Line a muffin tin with 12 rounds of puff pastry. Fill with 400ml custard thickened with 2 egg yolks and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Dust with cinnamon.

d.note: the boys' stop aboard the Titanic
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour over 1.25L ginger ale. Add a lemon slice to each. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
